controls.label: Shape
controls.title: Original radar reconstruction archived by NASA/JPL, at its published kilometer scale. The shared grid marks unavailable imagery. This is source geometry, not a photographic surface or reflectance map. The weak 2012–2013 radar data admit multiple shapes; the 2026 PDS release preserves the 2018 Model B rather than a new reconstruction. Apophis tumbles: the archived precession and rotation periods are 27.45 and 265.7 hours. This view uses a fixed illustrative frame, without propagating its tumbling attitude. No optical surface map is supplied. Lighting is illustrative in a fixed model frame.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.title: Color shows original model radius minus a 0.17 km reference sphere. It includes global shape and is not height above a gravitational equipotential. This is a derived view of the same radar reconstruction, not an independent topographic measurement. Display resolution adds no observational detail.
